text:
jo: Quick flag  the Python quickstart has drifted. Install line still says `pip install redwood-inference==0.8.0`, but published wheels are on 0.9.x. The snippet also uses `client.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='hi')` which raises a TypeError locally, and the retry example `Client(retry=True)` doesn't match the SDK (we now need a RetryConfig). Also the 'async client' link 404s.

kim: I hit this too. Minimal repro:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "qs.py", line 8, in <module>
    out = client.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='hey')
TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'model'
```

zoe: Looks like docs were drafted against 0.9 API shape. PyPI has 0.9.3 but some internal examples still pinned to 0.8.0. We should either update docs to the tested package or add a tiny compatibility alias in the SDK.

eng-doc: Prefer updating docs + put a clear changelog note. Aliases increase surface area and typing churn.

kim: I opened PR #510 to: update the pip line to `pip install redwood-inference==0.9.3`, change calls to `model_name='gpt-small'`, and replace `retry=True` with `retry_config=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3)` and `client.enable_retries()` where applicable. Also fixed the async link target.

doc-bot: LinkCheck: GET /docs/quickstart/python -> 404 on /docs/clients/python/async (reported at 2024-10-18T07:22:19Z).

pipetester: Strong +1 to adding a docs smoke-test GH Action. We can spin up a tiny matrix (3.10/3.11) that does `pip install -U redwood-inference==${PIN}` then runs the example file in a venv. If import/method names mismatch the job fails and we catch drift.

jo: One extra: make the runner set `REDWOOD_KEY=fake` and `REDWOOD_SKIP_NETWORK=1` so it validates import/typing/shape without hitting prod. I've seen CI flakes when env vars are missing.

zoe: I'll land the docs patch and add a follow-up issue to wire the smoke test into docs CI. I'll also add a short "Typing & upgrade notes" section explaining `Client` type hints and the move from `model` -> `model_name` plus example `from redwood import Client, Response`.

jo: Filed RW-8199 to track the umbrella work (quickstart drift: install, param rename, retry, async link, smoke test).

doc-bot: docs deploy succeeded for branch fix/quickstart-510 at 2024-10-20T16:40:05Z

kim: After merge I ran the updated snippet locally against 0.9.3 and it imports and the method names match. Leaving a note for support: if users hit `TypeError` on `generate(...)`, point them to RW-8199 and the updated quickstart. :thumbsup:
